{{Quote|I will command the ground forces in a frontal assault on the ruins of the capital city, Kesiak. Finally, Anakin's strike force will land on the planet behind the city and head for the Sith temple, to destroy the Reaper before it is activated.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="Game" />}}
The [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kesiak]] on [[Thule/Legends|Thule]] hosted a '''Sith temple''' in its downtown district around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Dark Reaper crisis]]. It was here that the forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] under the command of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] attempted to reactivate the [[Dark Reaper]],<ref name="Game" /> an ancient [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] superweapon<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|168|Dark Reaper}}</ref> constructed millennia prior at the [[Armory (Thule)|Thule armory]].<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> During the [[Battle of Thule]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] fought his way through Kesiak to the Sith Temple and destroyed the Dark Reaper using a [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130 ''Saber''-class fighter tank]].<ref name="Game" />
